title: Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Abductive learning (ABL) offers a promising framework that connects machine learning and logical reasoning in a mutually beneficial loop. However, this bidirectional feedback can also reinforce incorrect concept semantics, since different interpretations of intermediate concepts may explain the same observed reasoning outcomes. Static analyses characterize this ambiguity but leave open which explanation training selects and whether its labels can still be corrected. We develop a dynamical analysis of a fixed-feature binary ABL model that links the local stability of competing explanations to differences in their concept labels. We prove that Gram matrices with identical spectra can select different explanations even under the same supervision, objective, and initialization. When any two compatible explanations differ in at least two labels, legal evidence above one half guarantees during training that admissible changes in optimization g

translated_title: 反绎学习中的解释选择
translated_abstract: 反绎学习（ABL）提供了一个很有前景的框架，它将机器学习与逻辑推理连接在一个互利的循环之中。然而，这种双向反馈也可能强化错误的概念语义，因为对中间概念的不同解释可能会解释相同的观测推理结果。静态分析刻画了这种歧义性，但尚未回答训练究竟会选择哪种解释，以及其标签是否仍然可以被纠正。我们对一个固定特征的二值反绎学习模型建立了动力学分析，将相互竞争的解释的局部稳定性与其概念标签的差异联系起来。我们证明：即使在与相同的监督、目标和初始化条件下，具有相同谱的格拉姆矩阵也可能选择不同的解释。当任意两个相容解释在至少两个标签上存在差异时，高于二分之一合法证据能够在训练过程中保证优化的可允许变化……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文对反绎学习中的解释选择问题建立了动力学分析理论，证明了具有相同谱的格拉姆矩阵在相同条件下可能选出不同解释，并给出了训练过程中概念标签仍可被纠正的保证条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamical analysis of explanation selection in abductive learning, proving that Gram matrices with identical spectra can select different explanations under identical conditions and establishing guarantees for when concept labels can still be corrected during training.
